post_compile_completion_adapter.skipped_fresh_compile_prefix:
assert "--verify-existing" not in sys.argv, "Privacy target integration requires a fresh clean compile"
    assert "--selector-off" not in sys.argv and "--diagnostics-off" not in sys.argv, "Use the reviewed controlled H1 profile"
    data = PARENT.read_bytes()
    assert hashlib.sha256(data).hexdigest() == PARENT_SHA, "historical H1 builder changed"
    text = data.decode()
    # The pinned H1 adapter already sets every reviewed experimental selector.
    # Change only its explicit preparer/decoder selection; do not call H1 twice.
    old = "text=text.replace('lock_feedback','h1_right_modifiers')"
    assert text.count(old) == 1
    text = text.replace(old, "text=text.replace('lock_feedback','static_response_build_integration')")
    import prepare_sources as privacy
    assert pathlib.Path(privacy.__file__).resolve() == ROOT / "tests/static_response_build_integration/prepare_sources.py"
    original_overlay = privacy.overlay
    before_inputs = LOCAL_INPUTS()
    calls = []
    output = None if "--output-dir" not in sys.argv else pathlib.Path(sys.argv[sys.argv.index("--output-dir") + 1])

    def selected_overlay(sketch):
        assert not calls, "Privacy overlay must be applied exactly once"
        calls.append(str(sketch))
        original_overlay(sketch)
        rows = expected_inventory(sketch)
        privacy.verify_final(sketch)
        (output / "build-inputs.json").write_text(json.dumps(before_inputs, indent=2) + "\n")
        proof = dict(status="COMPOSED_NOT_YET_COMPILED", source_commit=CHECKPOINT,
                     selected_preparer="tests/static_response_build_integration/prepare_sources.py",
                     preparer_sha256=hashlib.sha256(pathlib.Path(privacy.__file__).read_bytes()).hexdigest(),
                     overlay_calls=len(calls), parent_overlay_calls="one static response target overlay -> reviewed streaming repair -> editor -> dashboard -> privacy -> H1; metadata identity last",
                     source_inventory=rows, changed_sources=["webfiles.h", "webserver.cpp", "caps_trial.h"],
                     unchanged_sources=198, comparison_base="privacy-fix1",
                     cumulative_h1_changed_sources=["cli.cpp", "webserver.cpp", "webfiles.h", "caps_trial.h"],
                     cumulative_h1_unchanged_sources=197, metadata_only_differences=["caps_trial.h: caps_trial::BuildId"],
                     dashboard_build_id='ROUTEB-STATIC-RESPONSE-REPAIR-v1',
                     dashboard_id_distinguishes_candidate=True, profile=PROFILE)
        assert output is not None
        (output / "static-response-composition.json").write_text(json.dumps(proof, indent=2) + "\n")

    privacy.overlay = selected_overlay
    namespace = {"__name__": "privacy_target_parent_adapter", "__file__": str(PARENT)}
    try:
        exec(compile(text, str(PARENT), "exec"), namespace)
        code = namespace["main"]()
    finally:
        privacy.overlay = original_overlay
    if code:
        return code
post_compile_completion_adapter.completion_setup:
assert sys.argv.count('--verify-existing') == 1, 'Completion-only flag required'
    assert '--selector-off' not in sys.argv and '--diagnostics-off' not in sys.argv
    output = pathlib.Path(sys.argv[sys.argv.index('--output-dir') + 1])
    import prepare_sources as privacy
    before_inputs = LOCAL_INPUTS()
    recorded = json.loads((output / 'static-response-composition.json').read_text())
    assert recorded['source_commit'] == CHECKPOINT and recorded['overlay_calls'] == 1
    assert recorded['source_inventory'] == expected_inventory(output / 'candidate/EvilDuckS3')
    privacy.verify_final(output / 'candidate/EvilDuckS3')
    calls = [str(output / 'candidate/EvilDuckS3')] * recorded['overlay_calls']
    old = "text=text.replace('lock_feedback','h1_right_modifiers')"
